aggregateQueries.users_missing_referrer_by_code: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE u.referred_by IS NOT NULL AND u.referred_by<>'' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users p WHERE p.referral_code=u.referred_by)
aggregateQueries.users_nonempty_referred_by: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE referred_by IS NOT NULL AND referred_by<>''
aggregateQueries.users_nullable_target_required_values: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE nickname IS NULL OR avatar IS NULL OR role IS NULL OR plan IS NULL OR created_at IS NULL OR updated_at IS NULL
aggregateQueries.users_unrecognized_lifecycle: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deletion_status NOT IN ('active','anonymized') OR (deletion_status='active' AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
aggregateQueries.users_email_phone_login_collision_pairs: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users a JOIN users b ON a.id<b.id WHERE (a.email IS NOT NULL AND a.email<>'' AND a.email COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci=b.phone COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) OR (b.email IS NOT NULL AND b.email<>'' AND b.email COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci=a.phone COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)
aggregateQueries.accounts_identity_groups: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(broker_server)),login_account FROM trading_accounts GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(broker_server)),login_account) x
aggregateQueries.accounts_identity_duplicate_groups: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(broker_server)),login_account FROM trading_accounts GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(broker_server)),login_account HAVING COUNT(*)>1) x
aggregateQueries.accounts_deleted_rows: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trading_accounts WHERE is_deleted<>0
aggregateQueries.bindings_currency_too_long: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt5_account_bindings WHERE CHAR_LENGTH(account_currency)>12
aggregateQueries.ownership_overlapping_pairs: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt5_account_ownership_history a JOIN mt5_account_ownership_history b ON a.id<b.id AND a.broker_server_key=b.broker_server_key AND a.login_account=b.login_account AND a.started_at<COALESCE(b.ended_at,'9999-12-31 23:59:59') AND b.started_at<COALESCE(a.ended_at,'9999-12-31 23:59:59')
aggregateQueries.bindings_current_owner_disagrees: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt5_account_bindings b JOIN trading_accounts a ON a.id=b.current_trading_account_id WHERE b.current_user_id<>a.user_id
aggregateQueries.bindings_open_interval_disagrees: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt5_account_bindings b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mt5_account_ownership_history o WHERE o.broker_server_key=b.broker_server_key AND o.login_account=b.login_account AND o.user_id=b.current_user_id AND o.trading_account_id=b.current_trading_account_id AND o.ended_at IS NULL)
aggregateQueries.ownership_identity_disagrees: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt5_account_ownership_history o JOIN trading_accounts a ON a.id=o.trading_account_id WHERE UPPER(TRIM(a.broker_server))<>UPPER(TRIM(o.broker_server_key)) OR a.login_account<>o.login_account
aggregateQueries.bridge_refresh_invalid_hash_format: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bridge_refresh_sessions WHERE token_hash NOT REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
aggregateQueries.bridge_refresh_inactive_user: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bridge_refresh_sessions s JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id WHERE u.deletion_status<>'active' OR u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
aggregateQueries.observer_bridge_user_not_admin: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_observer_sources s LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=s.bridge_user_id WHERE u.id IS NULL OR u.role<>'admin'
aggregateQueries.observer_channels_missing_source: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_observer_channels c LEFT JOIN ai_observer_sources s ON s.id=c.source_id WHERE s.id IS NULL
